## Description

Plan and assess worker inhalation-exposure monitoring for solvents (ethanol, isopropanol, methanol) and volatile raw materials in cosmetics manufacturing. Air-sampling strategy, OEL comparison, ventilation verification, respiratory-PPE selection, biological monitoring.
